Maria G: FYI brought up gptq-4b-small (8-bit) on dedicated for tool-calling evals, seeing structured-output failures in function calls
Aj Patel: what failures?
Maria G: model sometimes returns invalid JSON or wrong types for required fields. example:
Maria G: ```expected schema:
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "location": {"type": "string"},
    "temperature": {"type": "number"},
    "units": {"type": "string", "enum": ["C", "F"]}
  },
  "required": ["location", "temperature", "units"]
}
```
Maria G: but model returns: ```{"location":"SF","temperature":"21C","units":"C"}``` -> `temperature` is string -> parse fails
Kevin L: is this happening only with gptq quantized model?
Maria G: looks correlated: fp16 baseline ~98% schema compliance, gptq-8bit ~80% on our eval set
Samira: did eval-bot run the tool-calling enforcer with retries enabled?
eval-bot: automated run at 2026-02-17T14:12Z: 82% initial compliance, with 1 retry schema-validated -> 91% final compliance (retry=1)
Aj Patel: how are we doing retries? inline re-invoke or regenerate with `function_call`?
Kevin L: we call using structured `function_call` with `name` and `arguments`. Retry strategy: if schema validation fails, ask model to `re-call` the function with clarifying prompt and schema plus examples.
Maria G: sample retry prompt we used:
Maria G: ```Please re-call `weather.get` and return arguments that strictly conform to this JSON schema: <schema>. If a numeric value includes units, convert to a number (e.g., "21C" -> 21) and set `units` appropriately.
If you cannot determine a numeric value, return null for `temperature`.
```
Samira: sounds good. two follow-ups: 1) quantization may be degrading numeric formatting, consider post-token-filter that normalizes digits/units before parsing; 2) run targeted beam/temperature sweep on quantized checkpoint
Aj Patel: also we should add policy: parser tolerant JSON (allow numbers in strings) but log and count as warnings not passes
Kevin L: created a quick eval: `schema_compliance`, `parse_error_rate`, `retry_success_delta`, `avg_retries`, `pct_null_temps`
Maria G: rolling new job to compare gptq variants tonight. will post results. @Samira can you add a unit test to eval harness that asserts retry improves compliance by at least 5%?
Samira: on it :thumbsup: 
ci-bot: queued job #4582: ml-evals/structured-output/gptq-compare
Maria G: also note edge case: trailing commas from model output -> JSON parse error. adding code to strip trailing commas before parse as interim fix.
Aj Patel: open question: should we ban 4-bit quantized models for function-calling critical paths until we have schema-aware distillation?
Kevin L: note for docs: recommend `function_call: "auto"` + server-side schema validation + small retry policy. add example snippets to dev docs.
Maria G: ok will draft PR with guidance and sample code. thanks everyone.
